[package]
name = "localsearch"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = ["Martin Kavík <martin@kavik.cz>"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.61"

[dependencies]
fxhash = "0.2"
utf8-ranges = "1.0"
num-traits = "0.2"

[dependencies.fst]
version = "0.4"

[package]
name = "stremio-core"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = ["Smart Code OOD"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77"

[profile.release]
lto = true
opt-level = "s"

[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = ["stremio-core-web", "stremio-derive", "stremio-watched-bitfield"]

[features]
default = []
env-future-send = []
derive = []
analytics = []
deflate = ["stremio-official-addons/deflate"]

[dependencies]
stremio-official-addons = "=2.1.2"
serde_json = "1.0.*"
serde_path_to_error = "0.1"
serde_url_params = "0.2"
serde_bencode = "0.2.*"
stremio-serde-hex = "0.1"
flate2 = "1"
futures = "0.3"
http = "1.2"
percent-encoding = "2.1"
base64 = "0.22"
sha1 = "0.10"
sha2 = "0.10"
either = "1.6"
enclose = "1.1"
derivative = "2.2"
boolinator = "2.4"
lazysort = "0.2"
once_cell = "1"
itertools = "0.14"
magnet-url = "3.0"
data-encoding = "2.9"
hex = "0.4"
anyhow = "1.0"
thiserror = "2"
regex = "1.8"
tracing = "0.1"
lz-str = "0.2"

[dependencies.stremio-derive]
path = "stremio-derive"

[dependencies.stremio-watched-bitfield]
path = "stremio-watched-bitfield"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.serde_with]
version = "3.5"
features = ["macros", "chrono_0_4"]

[dependencies.url]
version = "2.4"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.semver]
version = "1"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.derive_more]
version = "2"
features = ["from", "into", "into_iterator", "try_into", "deref"]

[dependencies.strum]
version = "0.27"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.localsearch]
version = "0.1.0"
git = "https://github.com/Stremio/local-search"
branch = "main"

[dependencies.num]
version = "0.4.0"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies]
tokio-current-thread = "=0.2.0-alpha.1"
serde_test = "1.0"
assert_matches = "1.5"
pretty_assertions = "1"

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.12"
features = ["rt", "macros"]

[package]
name = "stremio-derive"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[lib]
proc-macro = true

[dependencies]
syn = "2"
quote = "1"
proc-macro2 = "1"
proc-macro-crate = "1"
proc_macro_roids = "0.8"
case = "1"

[package]
name = "stremio-watched-bitfield"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false
rust-version = "1.60"

[lib]
doctest = false

[features]
default = ["serde"]
serde = ["dep:serde"]

[dependencies]
base64 = "0.13.0"
flate2 = "1"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
default-features = false

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/stremio/local-search"]
git = "https://github.com/stremio/local-search"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
branch = "main"

[source."https://github.com/theguy000/stremio-core"]
git = "https://github.com/theguy000/stremio-core"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
branch = "fix/watched-bitfield-flate2"
